name: com.nobody-quits/nobodyquits
title: Nobody Quits
description: The book «From Voltage to Prompt» by Mike Fluff: contents, free parts, buying it, reader discussion.

tools.name: get_book_contents
tools.description: The contents of «From Voltage to Prompt. How Machines Learned to Make Music» by Mike Fluff: its sections and parts (slug, title, whether it is free to read), the price, and the URL of each part. Free parts read whole with read_part; the rest after the person buys the book (buy_book).

lang.description: Language of the edition: en, ru, es or pt.

tools.name: read_part
tools.description: The whole text of one part of the book, in the language asked (or Russian, the original, where a translation is missing). Free parts read for anyone; other parts for a person signed in with "nobodyquits:purchase" who owns the book.

lang.description: Language of the edition: en, ru, es or pt.

tools.name: buy_book
tools.description: For the person signed in with INITE ID ("nobodyquits:purchase"): a payment link for the whole book. The person pays on that page themselves (card or PIX) and every part opens for their account; nothing is charged by this call. Says so if they already own it. Only call when the person asks to buy the book.

lang.description: Language of the edition: en, ru, es or pt.

tools.name: get_chapter_discussion
tools.description: Return the published reader comments on one chapter of a Nobody Quits book: who wrote, the quoted passage, the text, replies (parent_id), likes, and a link to the place in the chapter; comments by the author are marked. Open for chapters the caller may read, by the site's own rules (send the reader's token for chapters that need one). Read-only.

lang.description: Edition (language of the text): each has its own discussion.

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: SIDE EFFECT: publishes a comment, in the signed-in person's name, in the public discussion of one chapter, where other readers see it. Use only when the person asks to post it, with words they approved. Optional `quote` pins it to a passage (copy it exactly from the chapter); `reply_to` answers a comment from get_chapter_discussion. Every comment goes through the site's moderation: one it holds is shown to the author only, and the result says so. Needs sign-in with the nobodyquits:discuss scope and a chapter the person may read. For a private remark to the author use send_note_to_author.

lang.description: Edition (language of the text): each has its own discussion.

body.description: The comment, as the person wants it published.

quote.description: An exact passage from the chapter the comment is about.

reply_to.description: Id of the comment this answers.

consent_ref.description: Only when the tool asked for a code: the reference it gave you.

consent_code.description: Only when the tool asked for a code: the six digits the person read to you. Never guess it.

tools.name: send_note_to_author
tools.description: SIDE EFFECT: emails the author a private note about one passage (a correction, a question, a remark) from the signed-in person, and keeps it in their notes on the site; the author can reply to the person's email. Use only when the person asks, with their words. `quote` must be copied exactly from the chapter (it finds the paragraph). Needs sign-in with the nobodyquits:discuss scope and a chapter the person may read. Nothing is published.

lang.description: Edition (language of the text): each has its own discussion.

quote.description: The passage, exactly as it is in the chapter.

note.description: What the person wants to tell the author.

consent_ref.description: Only when the tool asked for a code: the reference it gave you.

consent_code.description: Only when the tool asked for a code: the six digits the person read to you. Never guess it.

tools.name: get_author_inbox
tools.description: For the author only: the notes readers sent them and the comments that are hidden (held by moderation, or hidden by hand), newest first, each with a link to its place. Publish or hide with moderate_comment. Needs the author signed in with the nobodyquits:author scope. Read-only.

limit.description: At most this many of each.

tools.name: moderate_comment
tools.description: SIDE EFFECT: for the author only. `publish` shows a hidden or held comment to every reader of the chapter; `hide` takes one down (it stays visible to the author). Ids come from get_author_inbox or get_chapter_discussion. Needs the author signed in with the nobodyquits:author scope.
